user.title: Connect to C-Bus
user.description: Select the serial port connected to a C-Bus PCI. All published applications are monitored. Set the primary lighting application for the initial level scan (normally 56).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the C-Bus PCI. Check the serial proxy, wiring, and C-Bus power.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

send_command.name: Send application command
send_command.description: Send a named C-Bus command. Use the command reference for fields and units. Requires administrator access.

command.name: Command
command.description: A command name from the command reference.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: The exact named fields required by the command.
